## Summary

What does this change do, and why?

## Testing

Platforms and devices where it was built and played, and what was checked.

## Checklist

- [ ] Targets `develop`, not `master`.
- [ ] Builds without warnings and `ctest` passes.
- [ ] No data from the original game (`.deb`, `.hgr`, `.pvr`, sounds, music) is included.
- [ ] Code and documentation are in English; no comments in the code.
- [ ] If AI tools were used, this is stated above and every line was reviewed and tested.
